display_name: Architecture Review Project Card Machine Canon
description: Observer-only Architecture Review card lifecycle: insert, read, observe, analyze, report, eject; no KANDA apply/rollback authority over Project source.
user_intent_examples: Bind this Architecture Review target to one current operation and lifecycle generation.
Block switching while a worker, cancellation, apply outcome, or transaction is unresolved.
Eject target-specific Tool state only after verified completion or rollback.
when_to_load: When Architecture Review, AST audit, Planner/Workbench proposal, Project-root/target switching, stale async results, source refresh, reports, or card eject must preserve observer identity without Project source authority.
when_not_to_load: Do not load for payment-card discussion, generic UI styling, or Tool/Project boundary tasks with no Architecture Review lifecycle consequence.
do_not_regress: The Tool is the reusable observer card machine; the Project owns source and durable results.
MCard never applies, installs, validates-as-authority, or rolls back external Project source.
Source fingerprint changes invalidate old observation generations.
Card eject remains available and never requires Project rollback.
Project development remains possible without KANDA Reasoner.
KPR-12-001 remains the root and ownership identity owner.
